cohort: The study included surgical patients who received general anesthesia and provided written informed consent.
finding: Delayed awakening after general anesthesia was significantly linked to factors such as older age (>64 years), diploma anesthesia providers, opioid administration, longer surgery duration (>2h), higher estimated blood loss (>1500 ml), larger crystalloid administration (>3000 ml), intraoperative hypotension, and extreme body weight.
